frames.title: GEOS-FP Precipitation and Clouds
frames.description: Precipitation and clouds are calculated using fields from NASA’s GEOS-FP system. GEOS-FP combines millions of weather observations with a predictive model to create a global best estimate of weather conditions, which can be used to estimate the formation of clouds along with rain and snowfall.

frames.relation: Rain and clouds from NASA's GEOS weather model for recent days: a model, like the POWER values in the sound. The sound uses POWER rainfall for one place over 2015–2024.

frames.title: GEOS-FP Near-Surface Temperature
frames.description: Near-surface temperature is calculated by sampling 3-D atmospheric fields from NASA’s GEOS-FP system 3 meters above Earth’s surface. GEOS-FP combines millions of weather observations with a predictive model to create a global best estimate of weather conditions that are used to begin a forecast.
